_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Raunou fou - Taunu o loʻo toe: {dice_summary}
O au taunu e teu nei: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Tagata taʻalo {current_player_id} e valaʻau! O le numera moni o le mata {face_value} o loʻo iai {count}, lea e >= {quantity}.
Tagata taʻalo {loser_id} (o le valaʻau) e leai se taunu.

action.bid_announce: O le tagata taalo {player_id} e faia se tauofoga o foliga {quantity} ma mata {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: O se valaauga na faia e aunoa ma ni tauofoga muamua.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Le faʻagauga le iloa e pei o se '[Bid: X, Y]' poʻo se '[Call]' faʻamaoni. Faʻagauga na tuʻuina atu: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: O le aofaʻi fou {new_quantity} e laʻititi ifo nai lo le taimi nei {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: O le tau fou {new_face_value} e maualalo ifo nai lo le taimi nei {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: E tutusa le tauofoga ma le tau o loo iai nei.
bid_reason.face_range: O le tau e tatau ona i ai i le va o le 1 ma le 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: O le tagata taalo {player_id} na faʻateʻaina e ala i se gaioiga le aoga.

outcome.win: Tagata taʻalo {winner} manumalo! Faʻaiʻuga o le faʻasologa: {final_ranking}
